result.name: Spring4Shell: Spring Framework Remote Code Execution (CVE-2022-22965)
result.description: Spring Framework versions 5.3.0 through 5.3.17 running on JDK 9+ contain an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability via DataBinder parameter binding.

nvt.solution: Upgrade Spring Framework to version 5.3.18, 5.2.20 or newer.

result.name: SMBv1 Protocol Active (EternalBlue / WannaCry Exposure)
result.description: The legacy and deprecated SMBv1 protocol is enabled on the remote Windows server. This allows remote attackers to exploit EternalBlue and rapidly propagate ransomware throughout the enterprise.

nvt.solution: Disable the SMBv1 protocol completely via Group Policy (GPO) or PowerShell.

result.name: SNMP Default Community String 'public' Detected
result.description: The remote SNMP server responds to the factory default community string 'public'. An attacker can query this service to extract sensitive network configuration and host statistics.

nvt.solution: Change the default community string and migrate to SNMPv3 with authentication and encryption enabled.
